fields.name: ElectionType
fields.about: Type of elections to conduct for the partition. A value of '0' elects the preferred replica. A value of '1' elects the first live replica if there are no in-sync replica.

fields.name: TopicPartitions
fields.about: The topic partitions to elect leaders.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partitions of this topic whose leader should be elected.

fields.name: TimeoutMs
fields.about: The time in ms to wait for the election to complete.
